title: Loop+ Relief on Late Returns in Marketplace Orders Replacement-Charge Refunds
content:
**Rule.** The Loop+ relief factor of the Marketplace Orders replacement-charge refund applies only to an original first-scanned inside the grace: a Loop+ membership in good standing (trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending) on an annual plan (Loop+ Annual, Loop+ Household Annual, Loop+ Student Annual) takes the annual relief factor of 0.5; one in good standing on a monthly plan (Loop+ Access Monthly, Loop+ Student Monthly, Loop+ Monthly) takes the monthly relief factor of 0.75; any other buyer, or any original scanned after the grace, takes a factor of one.

The relief factor multiplies the late-return rate of the refund and no other rate; the relieved late-return rate is the one combined with any other rate the refund withholds, the combined rate being capped at the whole (one) and applied once to the refundable charge, giving the deductions, rounded half up to the cent; the deductions are subtracted from the refundable charge, and the refund never falls below zero.

The record read is the buyer's Loop+ Membership: its status and its plan.

## Factor by membership and scan

| Original first-scanned inside the grace | Membership status | Plan | Relief factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | good standing | annual | 0.5 |
| yes | good standing | monthly | 0.75 |
| yes | pending, lapsed, cancelled, or no membership | — | one |
| no (after the grace, or never scanned) | any | any | one |

### Hypothetical case

A late-return rate of 16% for a buyer on Loop+ Annual in active status becomes 16% times 0.5, that is 8%; on Loop+ Monthly it becomes 16% times 0.75, that is 12%.
